cpu.desc: CPU allocation in threads. 100% = 1 thread, 200% = 2 threads, 1000% = 10 threads

disk.desc: Disk space allocation in MB (10240 MB = 10 GB)

memory.desc: How much memory in MB to allocate

ip.desc: What IP to bind the server to

port.desc: Port the web server listens on (TCP). It is also passed to the app as the PORT environment variable

gitrepo.desc: HTTPS URL of a git repository to download on install, for example https://github.com/user/my-bot.git. Reinstalling pulls the latest commit. Leave empty to upload the files yourself

gitbranch.desc: Branch to check out. Empty means the default branch of the repository

gittoken.desc: Personal access token for a private repository (GitHub, GitLab). Leave empty for public repositories

framework.desc: What the app is built with. A framework sends every request that is not a file to public/index.php. WordPress is downloaded on install when the server folder has none

docroot.desc: Folder served on the web, relative to the server folder. Empty: public when it exists, otherwise the server folder (Plain PHP), public (Symfony, CodeIgniter, Slim), the server folder (WordPress)

installonstart.desc: Run composer install before every start when there is a composer.json, so packages added to it are picked up

nodev.desc: Install with composer install --no-dev, leaving out require-dev. Only for apps configured for production

workers.desc: PHP processes that answer requests at the same time (PHP_CLI_SERVER_WORKERS). 1 answers one request at a time

phpflags.desc: Extra php.ini settings for the web server, for example -d upload_max_filesize=64M -d post_max_size=64M

bash -c "set -e; if [ -z \"$GIT_REPO\" ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ \"$(id -u)\" = 0 ] && command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"Installing git in the install container\"; apt-get update -qq >/dev/null && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates >/dev/null; else echo \"git is not installed, it is needed to download the repository\"; exit 1; fi; fi; g() { git -c safe.directory='*' -c init.defaultBranch=main -c advice.detachedHead=false \"$@\"; }; auth=(); if [ -n \"$GIT_TOKEN\" ]; then auth=(-c \"http.extraHeader=Authorization: Basic $(printf 'oauth2:%s' \"$GIT_TOKEN\" | base64 | tr -d '\\n')\"); fi; [ -d .git ] || g init -q; echo \"Fetching $GIT_REPO ${GIT_BRANCH:-(default branch)}\"; g \"${auth[@]}\" fetch -q --depth 1 \"$GIT_REPO\" \"${GIT_BRANCH:-HEAD}\"; g reset -q --hard FETCH_HEAD; echo \"Checked out $(g log -1 --format='%h %s')\""

Upload your app, or set a git repository and reinstall.\"; exit 0; fi; if [ \"${framework}\" != plain ]; then export AETHER_FRONT_CONTROLLER=1; fi; echo \"Serving $d on port ${port} with PHP $(php -r 'echo PHP_VERSION;') and ${workers} workers\"; exec php -d memory_limit=${memory}M ${phpflags} -S 0.0.0.0:${port} -t \"$d\" .aether/router.php"

pre.text:
<?php
// Router for PHP's built-in web server, written by Aether Panel before every start (edits are lost).
// Hidden files and folders (.env, .git, .aether) are never served, nor vendor/ and the Composer
// files when the document root is the project folder. With a framework, files that exist are
// served as they are and every other request goes to the front controller index.php.
$root = rtrim($_SERVER['DOCUMENT_ROOT'], '/');
$path = rawurldecode(parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'], PHP_URL_PATH) ?? '/');
if (preg_match('#/\.(?!well-known/)#', $path) || (is_file($root . '/composer.json') && preg_match('#^/(vendor/|composer\.(json|lock)$)#', $path))) {
    http_response_code(404);
    echo "Not Found\n";
    return true;
}
if (getenv('AETHER_FRONT_CONTROLLER') !== '1') {
    return false;
}
$file = $root . $path;
if ($path !== '/' && (is_file($file) || (is_dir($file) && (is_file($file . '/index.php') || is_file($file . '/index.html'))))) {
    return false;
}
$_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'] = '/index.php';
$_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] = $root . '/index.php';
$_SERVER['PHP_SELF'] = '/index.php';
chdir($root);
require $root . '/index.php';
